Audit Application Group Management generates events for actions related to application groups, such as group creation, modification, addition or removal of group member and some
other actions.
Application groups are used by Authorization Manager.
Audit Application Group Management subcategory is out of scope of this document, because Authorization Manager is very rarely in use and it is deprecated starting from Windows
Server 2012.
